New assigned task 88: Community thread-tree SDK contract seam

Execute exactly one verified ChangeSet: cs-community-thread-tree-sdk-contract-fd001-alignment.

Source/result chain: task84 completed/promoted cs-community-thread-tree-adapter-postgres-ltree-contract-fd001-alignment at commit edb899a5. Continue IP-005 thread-tree upward to the SDK/client contract seam: typed, tenant-safe SDK request/response builders for thread tree read/list/post-reply surfaces, backed by existing kernel/domain/usecase/API contracts and adapter plan semantics. This is deterministic SDK contract work; do not claim live HTTP runtime, browser/mobile client readiness, or p99 closure.

Owned scope only: existing worker-3 community/root-manifest worktree; Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock only as required by serialized worker-3 new-crate/root-manifest lane; crates/oya-community-thread-tree-sdk/**; registry/catalog/oya-community-thread-tree-sdk.yaml; microservices/community/catalog/oya-community-thread-tree-sdk.yaml if fidelity requires; evidence/fd001/cs-community-thread-tree-sdk-contract-fd001-alignment-*; evidence/multispectrum/cs-community-thread-tree-sdk-contract-fd001-alignment.json. Do not touch mail, messenger, OpenAPI runtime bindings, deployment/bootstrap, unrelated community post-store files, or prior evidence except reading task75/task79/task84 evidence and post-store SDK patterns.

Before editing, load root/spec authority, planning-closure gate, microservices/community/IP-005-thread-tree-materialised-path.md, ADR-COMM-0005, task75/task79/task84 evidence, post-store SDK patterns, and involved thread-tree kernel/domain/usecase/API/adapter types. Claim OMX task + Oya VCS before writes. Implement clean-architecture SDK contract only: typed request/response builders, idempotency key handling for post-reply, tenant/thread/path isolation, redacted error labels, pagination/depth bounds, deterministic serialization metadata, and no network/socket/fake server/runtime claims. Tests must be non-empty and prove tenant required, path/thread mismatch rejection where represented, depth/page bounds, idempotency propagation, redacted error output, deterministic ordering metadata, and API/usecase type fidelity.

Verify fmt, focused SDK tests, package tests, nextest, clippy, cargo metadata, planning-closure, data-class, architecture-boundaries, catalog, dependency-seam, diff-check, Oya VCS verify/done/promote, commit. Result must include exact evidence paths/not-tested gaps and a line starting exactly: Subagent skip reason: serialized worker-3 community root-manifest/new-crate SDK lane; active OMX team already parallelizes worker-1 mail and worker-2 messenger lanes.
